scope: Candidate review only. No production audio mapping is changed before user selection.
bgm_policy: Preserve both existing BGM files and references byte-for-byte.

cues.event: The crumpled fortune paper lands on the ending beetle's head.
cues.timing: Immediate at the visible head contact frame.
cues.fallback_policy: Keep the current generic impact only as a load/decode fallback.
cues.decision_reason: The current hard-surface marble impact does not communicate a light crumpled-paper bonk.

cues.event: The fortune words begin revealing across the unfolded paper.
cues.timing: Start on the first visible word; the useful body may support the opening part of the reveal.
cues.fallback_policy: Silence if the selected file fails to load.
cues.decision_reason: The reveal is a major ceremonial beat and currently has no independent audible identity.

cues.event: The fortune paper dissolves into light motes after the reading hold.
cues.timing: Start at dissolve onset and resolve within VANISH_DUR.
cues.fallback_policy: Silence if the selected file fails to load.
cues.decision_reason: The visual dissolve closes the ending ceremony and currently fades without a matching sound.
